lines: Sudden collapse at train station following chest pain and confusion, requiring CPR and defibrillation

This 59-year-old male with coronary artery disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and recent massive hemoptysis and beta-blocker overdose is brought to the emergency department after collapsing suddenly at a train station.
Bystanders report he had been clutching his chest and appeared confused before losing consciousness.
He received immediate CPR, and paramedics delivered multiple shocks via automated external defibrillator (AED).
